description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for Spark ML components, including loading operators, deserializing vectors and matrices, setting parameters, and managing ML model instances within Spark Connect. It also includes reflection-based method invocation with security checks.

classes.name: MLUtils
classes.description: Object containing utility functions for Spark ML components, including operator loading, parameter setting, deserialization, and reflection-based method invocation.

methods.name: loadOperators
methods.description: Loads registered ML operators via ServiceLoader and returns a map of name to class.

methods.name: deserializeVector
methods.description: Deserializes a proto expression struct into a Spark ML Vector.

methods.name: deserializeMatrix
methods.description: Deserializes a proto expression struct into a Spark ML Matrix.

methods.name: setInstanceParams
methods.description: Sets parameters on an ML Params instance from a proto MlParams object.

methods.name: parseRelationProto
methods.description: Transforms a proto Relation into a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates an ML estimator or transformer instance from class map, name, uid, and optional params.

methods.name: replaceOperator
methods.description: Replaces an operator name with a backend-provided value if available.

methods.name: getEstimator
methods.description: Retrieves an Estimator instance based on proto operator info and optional params.

methods.name: getTransformer
methods.description: Retrieves a Transformer instance from proto transform info or operator info.

methods.name: loadOperator
methods.description: Loads an ML component (Estimator, Transformer, or Evaluator) from a given path.

methods.name: loadEstimator
methods.description: Loads an Estimator from a specified path.

methods.name: loadTransformer
methods.description: Loads a Transformer from a specified path.

methods.name: loadEvaluator
methods.description: Loads an Evaluator from a specified path.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Saves an MLWritable instance to a specified path with options.
